title: Resume guidance in a later driver call without recursive callbacks
narrative: Fangore starts the CLI host with family `pass_through` and backend `mock`, loads the `verify_repair` durable graph (controller `session`, store `memory`). Frontier and other MCP-capable clients cannot reenter a model session during a pending tool call. Guidance therefore returns as an ordinary tool result; the same driving session calls resume later with the answer. Tracks R-IOC-SESSION. He walks product steps (start, answer) and verifies completion from the structured observation expects on this scenario. [^insp-ioc-03]
implementation: `DurableGraphGenerator.start` returns a committed `GraphYield`; `resume` is a separate operation with `expected_sequence`. No recursive callback into an outstanding tool call is required. MCP adapter: `mechaharness.mcp_graph_driver` (unit/doctest).
validation: Harness `user_story` scenario `session.yaml`: environment + graph + steps + complete expects.
